note: Fixed mains-powered ultrasonic emitter (traffic-light / LED-driver / SMPS / presence-sensor class) - NOT a data beacon. Field-identified Stockholm 2026-08-21, heard on two independent phones (Pixel 11 Pro + NX809J) at one fixed spot. 7 stable simultaneous tones ~18.75-19.50 kHz (18750,18844,18891,19055,19148,19195,19500), continuous, no clock, no payload. The app's hop/Lisnr/Fidzup detectors fragment it into ML-hop-* phantoms; this canonical signature names the real source.

family: Stockholm Central PA/VA pilot tone (EN 54 line supervision)
note: Continuous CW pilot tone of the Stockholm Central station public-address / voice-alarm (evacuation) system: an inaudible ~20 kHz tone injected on every loudspeaker line so the EN 54-16 controller can supervise line impedance and detect open/short faults. NOT a tracking beacon, carries no data. Field-identified 2026-08-22 (Pixel 11 Pro), heard identically inside McDonald's and Burger King in the station hall: 19983.0 Hz, std 0.08 Hz over 85 min (crystal-derived), no Doppler, no keying, random multipath fading only; secondary stable lines 15848.6 and 23882.6 Hz (outside the 18-22 kHz hunter band). The app cannot decode or classify it because there is nothing to decode: a bare carrier.
